factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for olive rockfish.
factors.value_notes: The reviewed NOAA and species-synthesis sources describe range, kelp-forest habitat and depth, but do not provide a numeric preferred SST curve for olive rockfish. The configured 10-18 °C range and 12-16 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific temperature evidence; retain values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for olive rockfish.
factors.value_notes: NOAA's 2026 Pacific groundfish synthesis reports all life stages in kelp forests to 172 m; the NOAA AFSC guide reports common depth of 0-16 fathoms (0-30 m) and a maximum around 146 m. This supports broad depth use but shows the configured 5-80 m band is not a complete species depth envelope and the 7-75 m ideal is not a measured preference.
